Key developments (last 30 min)

  • Houthi missile/drone wave toward southern Israel; Red Sea shipping risk raised. AP reports attack; Houthis claim second wave.
  • Strikes reported on Masoudieh barracks and a residential building in southeast Tehran. Local reports say buildings hit; casualties unconfirmed.
  • Interceptions over Erbil, Iraq — incoming missiles/drones shot down.
  • Hezbollah-affiliated brigades in Iraq announce deeper involvement. Pledge to increase ballistic missile and drone launches toward Israel.
  • Northern border remains active daily with Hezbollah attacks and counterstrikes.
  • U.S. reportedly fired ~850 Tomahawks in four weeks (~25% of pre-war inventory). High missile expenditure strains stockpiles.
  • President Trump announced a second 10-day pause on energy-target strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request; Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First pause was violated.
  • Iran allows Hormuz passage for selected friendly nations (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Raises trade and insurance complications.
  • Iranian opposition leader (Pahlavi) warns against striking a deal with current regime.

🟢 Good News

  • Interceptions over Erbil confirm active defenses working.
  • Temporary U.S. pause could open a negotiation window if honored.

Bottom line

Threat assessment: Escalating.

מסקנה

הערכת איום: מתחרפת.

  • IDF/US completed multiple large strike waves on Tehran today — third wave reported.
  • Israeli strikes reported on Hezbollah positions in Beirut and the Beqaa. Northern border active daily.
  • Interceptions recorded over Erbil, Iraq.
  • Reported strikes on Masoudieh, Soltani Alley and near Evin Prison in Tehran; reservoir hit in Haftgel (Khuzestan).

  • Reports of increased Hezbollah-affiliated missile/drone activity from Iraq.

  • Trump announced a second 10-day pause on energy-target strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request and “talks going very well.”
  • Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan acting as mediator.
  • Iran allows passage through Hormuz for selected states (Russia, India, China); other ships still restricted.
  • Tactical context:
  • Third wave of strikes on Tehran in one day indicates sustained deep-strike campaign.
  • High TLAM usage suggests diminishing US long-range cruise inventory; may change strike tempo.
  • Proxy fronts (Hezbollah, Houthis, militias in Iraq) are expanding attacks and range toward Israel.
  • Intelligence hits:
  • Senior Iranian weapons-research official Ali Fouladvand reported killed.
  • 🟢 Good News:
  • Air defenses recorded successful interceptions (Erbil). A formal pause on energy strikes is in effect for 10 days.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — high strike tempo, multi-front proxy activity, and heavy cruise-missile expenditure.
